levels.title: Total Spotify Streams
levels.task: Your boss at Stellar Sound wants one number: the sum of all Spotify streams on the Top 50 chart. Return one row, one column, named exactly total_spotify_streams (use SUM).
levels.solution: SELECT SUM(spotify_streams) AS total_spotify_streams FROM top_songs;
levels.hintMessage: The column name must be total_spotify_streams. One SELECT is enough.
levels.successMessage: Nice! Now your boss has the total numbers.

levels.title: Shortest Song by Artist
levels.task: The social team at Stellar Sound is making a short video about Benson Boone. They need his shortest song length in milliseconds. Return one number column named exactly shortest_song (use MIN) for his rows only.
levels.solution: SELECT MIN(duration_ms) AS shortest_song FROM top_songs WHERE artist = 'Benson Boone';
levels.hintMessage: Name the column shortest_song. Filter with WHERE artist = 'Benson Boone'.
levels.successMessage: Perfect, now the team can make the tiktok.

levels.title: Song Count by Genre
levels.task: A genre specialist at Stellar Sound wants a count per genre. Show genre and song_count (COUNT(*) for each group). Sort by genre A–Z so the order is fixed.
levels.solution: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS song_count FROM top_songs GROUP BY genre ORDER BY genre;
levels.hintMessage: GROUP BY genre, use COUNT(*) AS song_count, then ORDER BY genre.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The label can see how many songs sit in each genre.

levels.title: Average Song Duration by Album
levels.task: The studio team at Stellar Sound wants the average song length per album. Show album_name first, then AVG(duration_ms) with no short name on the average. Sort albums A–Z.
levels.solution: SELECT album_name, AVG(duration_ms) FROM top_songs GROUP BY album_name ORDER BY album_name;
levels.hintMessage: First column album_name, second AVG(duration_ms). ORDER BY album_name.
levels.successMessage: Great! The engineers can plan timing with these averages.

levels.title: Most Recent Release by Artist
levels.task: Leadership at Stellar Sound wants the newest release date for each artist. Columns: artist, max_release_date (use MAX on release_date). Sort with newest dates first, then artist A–Z when dates tie.
levels.solution: SELECT artist, MAX(release_date) AS max_release_date FROM top_songs GROUP BY artist ORDER BY max_release_date DESC, artist;
levels.hintMessage: GROUP BY artist, alias max_release_date, ORDER BY max_release_date DESC, artist.
levels.successMessage: Great! This list helps the team spot who released music most recently.
